raw.description: 对方每有1只精灵的信仰对象是自身，自身造成的攻击伤害提升20%、受到的攻击伤害减少10%；回合开始时，若对方的信仰对象均为自身，则本场战斗自身免疫受到的异常状态、能力下降状态、固定伤害、百分比伤害|对手的信仰对象不为其时自身抵挡对手的致命一击，抵挡成功则将对手的信仰对象改为其且当回合战斗阶段结束时附加免疫量100%的百分比伤害；战斗阶段结束时，若本回合对手未打出致命一击，则自身恢复最大体力的1/4|（boss无效）

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review
review.rationale: 最新回答两处其均指教皇，免疫量以整次技能最终结算口径；当前归信变化、完整抵挡和反伤与零红事件当前实现，真实全队判定独立延期。
review.singleBehavior: 当前敌信仰教皇提供20%红增与10%红减；非教皇归信时按本次技能开招资格抵挡其暴击的最终量，盾罩/其他减免免疫先结算，正数抵挡后归信教皇；每个整次技能战阶结束按完整抵挡量100%附粉，HP不足不截免疫量；已经归信后的下一次攻击不再抵挡；对手该回合无暴击则恢复1/4。
review.deferredBehavior: 真实其他对方队伍成员信仰自身时逐只+20%攻击伤害/-10%所受攻击伤害；回合开始真实对方全部成员均信仰自身时本场免异常、免能力下降、免固定、免百分比。
review.trigger: 对方每有1只精灵的信仰对象是自身；若对方的信仰对象均为自身

success.name: 4898真实2084当前对手信仰自身才增红20%与减红10%，固定百分比不机械改变
success.assertion: test('4898真实2084当前对手信仰自身才增红20%与减红10%，固定百分比不机械改变',()=>{const results=[];for(const faith of[undefined,0,1]){const s=make({move:11141,soul:true});(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=faith;let outgoing,incoming;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeDamage'&&c.a.side===0)outgoing=c.modifier;if(e==='beforeIncomingAttack'&&c.a.side===0)incoming=c.reduction;},()=>turn(s,11141,10716));results.push({outgoing,incoming});assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),50);}assert.equal(results[1].outgoing,results[0].outgoing*1.2);assert.equal(results[2].outgoing,results[0].outgoing);assert.ok(Math.abs(results[1].incoming-.1)<1e-12);assert.equal(results[0].incoming,0);assert.equal(results[2].incoming,0);});

success.name: 4898真实2084无对手暴击战斗阶段回复四分之一，技能禁疗不封魂印，药剂或控制未攻击也可回复
success.assertion: test('4898真实2084无对手暴击战斗阶段回复四分之一，技能禁疗不封魂印，药剂或控制未攻击也可回复',()=>{for(const mode of['status','potion','control']){const s=make({move:20276,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(s,0,'无法通过自身技能恢复体力');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']=3;turn(s,20276,mode==='potion'?null:20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,3250);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].moves.every(k=>s.fighters[0].pp[k]>=0));}});

success.name: 4898真实2084当前信仰贡献不冒充全队归信免疫；自身异常弱化固定与百分比仍实际生效
success.assertion: test('4898真实2084当前信仰贡献不冒充全队归信免疫；自身异常弱化固定与百分比仍实际生效',()=>{const s=make({move:20276,soul:true});(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=0;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);c.stage(c.t,-1,['def']);c.hurt(c.t,100,'固定试验','fixed');c.hurt(c.t,200,'百分比试验','percent');}},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,-1);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(sum(s,'fixed',1),100);assert.ok(sum(s,'percent',1)>=200);});

success.name: 4898真实2084暴击抵挡按已答归信并附最终免疫量；已标记本回合暴击的准备前态不回复
success.assertion: test('4898真实2084暴击抵挡按已答归信并附最终免疫量；已标记本回合暴击的准备前态不回复',()=>{const a=make({move:20276,soul:true,hp:1000});timer(a,1,'必定暴击');turn(a,20276,10127);assert.equal(a.round,2);assert.equal(a.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);assert.ok(a.fighters[0].soulState.pope4898.uses[0].blocked>0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,1000);const b=make({move:20276,soul:true,hp:1000});b.fighters[0].soulState.pope4898.opponentCritRound=1;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].hp,1000);});

success.name: 4898全部17招真实2084原生有序实例及64种子基础命中、先制与暴击状态
success.assertion: test('4898全部17招真实2084原生有序实例及64种子基础命中、先制与暴击状态',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const h=require('./helpers/remaining-4898.cjs'),s=make({move:m.id,soul:true}),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,source.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');assert.deepEqual(s.moveDefinitions[key(m.id)].operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]),compiled.operations.map(op=>[op.effectId,op.index,op.params]));turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[0].hp)&&Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.id===38374?m.pp:m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.round,2);require('./helpers/next50-base-probe.cjs').verify({...h,source:{...source,moves:[m]}});console.log('#4898 base '+m.id);}});

success.name: 4898已答归信：非教皇信仰对象的暴击由教皇抵挡并改信教皇，已信教皇不再抵挡；暴击零红不误触四分一回血
success.assertion: for(const faith of[undefined,1,0]){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1000});(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=faith;timer(s,1,'必定暴击');turn(s,20276,10127);const st=s.fighters[0].soulState.pope4898,blocked=st.uses.filter(e=>e.blocked>0);if(faith===0){assert.equal(blocked.length,0);assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000-sum(s,'attack',1));}else{assert.equal(blocked.length,1);assert.equal(sum(s,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),blocked[0].blocked);}assert.equal(st.opponentCritRound,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].ailments['狂信'],undefined);}

success.name: 4898已答最终量：完整技能多段共享抵挡资格，盾和减伤及其他免疫先算，按每次技能最终抵挡量附粉；不是理论量或HP损失
success.assertion:
for(const mode of['normal','reduction-shield','immune','full-shield']){const create=()=>{const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:8000,enemyLoadout:[10713,20117,10127,20309,37911]});timer(s,1,'必定暴击');if(mode==='reduction-shield'){timer(s,0,'额外攻击减伤',{fraction:.5});timer(s,0,'伤害定额减免',{amount:1});S.refresh(s.fighters[0],10,'pope-test-shield');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[0],20,'pope-test-barrier');}if(mode==='immune')timer(s,0,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='full-shield')S.refresh(s.fighters[0],10000,'pope-test-full');return s;};const a=create(),b=create();turn(a,20276,10713);try{abilities.block=(c,use)=>{original(c,use);return Math.max(0,c.amount);};turn(b,20276,10713);}finally{abilities.block=original;}const st=a.fighters[0].soulState.pope4898,use=st.uses[0],expected=sum(b,'attack',1);assert.ok(use.segments.length>=2);assert.equal(use.blocked,expected);assert.equal(sum(a,'attack',1),0);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].hp,8000);assert.equal(sum(a,'percent'),expected);if(expected>0){assert.equal(a.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);assert.equal(st.events.filter(e=>e.event==='retaliation').length,1);}else{assert.equal(a.fighters[1].statusState?.faithSourceSide,undefined);assert.equal(st.events.filter(e=>e.event==='retaliation').length,0);}if(mode==='reduction-shield'){assert.equal(S.sourceValue(a.fighters[0],'pope-test-shield'),S.sourceValue(b.fighters[0],'pope-test-shield'));assert.equal(S.barrierSourceValue(a.fighters[0],'pope-test-barrier'),S.barrierSourceValue(b.fighters[0],'pope-test-barrier'));}}
 const low=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,hp:1});timer(low,1,'必定暴击');turn(low,20276,10127);const blocked=low.fighters[0].soulState.pope4898.uses[0].blocked;assert.ok(blocked>1);assert.equal(low.fighters[0].hp,1);assert.equal(sum(low,'percent'),blocked);

success.name: 4898已答整次技能：真实星皇额外攻击另开一次，首次归信后后续暴击正常承伤；抵挡统计不并入下一次技能
success.assertion: const emperor=require('../local-species.cjs').species(3291),ids=[30376,25294,25295,30380,30381],seen=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=16;seed++){const s=make({move:20276,index:-1,soul:true,enemySource:emperor,enemyLoadout:ids,enemySoul:true,seed:Math.imul(seed,0x9e3779b1)>>>0});timer(s,1,'必定暴击');turn(s,20276,30380);const uses=s.fighters[0].soulState.pope4898.uses;assert.equal(uses.filter(e=>e.blocked>0).length,1);const received=s.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.targetSide===0);seen.add(received.length);if(received.length>1){assert.ok(sum(s,'attack',1)>0);assert.ok(uses.length>1);assert.equal(uses[1].eligibleAtStart,false);}assert.equal(new Set(uses.map(e=>e.key)).size,uses.length);}assert.deepEqual([...seen].sort(),[1,2]);

success.assertion: test('4898/4自身特攻一级、5重复双降与概率弱攻、33真实清强、31多段红伤、76固定100连续五回',()=>{const a=make({move:20276});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);const b=make({move:20565});turn(b,20565,null);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.spa,-1);const c=make({move:11148});c.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(c,11148,null);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].stages.def,0);const d=make({move:10703});turn(d,10703,null);assert.ok(d.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);const e=make({move:11143,loadout:[11143,20276,11141,20567,38375]});for(let r=1;r<=6;r++){turn(e,r===1?11143:20276,20117);assert.equal(sum(e,'fixed'),r<=5?100:0);}const weak=new Set(),fear=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const w=make({move:11144,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(w,11144,null);weak.add(w.fighters[1].stages.atk);const f=make({move:11147,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(f,11147,null);fear.add(!!f.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}assert.deepEqual([...weak].sort(),[-1,0]);assert.deepEqual([...fear].sort(),[false,true]);});

success.assertion: test('4898/4自身特攻一级、5重复双降与概率弱攻、33真实清强、31多段红伤、76固定100连续五回',()=>{const a=make({move:20276});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);const b=make({move:20565});turn(b,20565,null);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.spa,-1);const c=make({move:11148});c.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(c,11148,null);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].stages.def,0);const d=make({move:10703});turn(d,10703,null);assert.ok(d.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);const e=make({move:11143,loadout:[11143,20276,11141,20567,38375]});for(let r=1;r<=6;r++){turn(e,r===1?11143:20276,20117);assert.equal(sum(e,'fixed'),r<=5?100:0);}const weak=new Set(),fear=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const w=make({move:11144,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(w,11144,null);weak.add(w.fighters[1].stages.atk);const f=make({move:11147,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(f,11147,null);fear.add(!!f.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}assert.deepEqual([...weak].sort(),[-1,0]);assert.deepEqual([...fear].sort(),[false,true]);});

interaction.name: 4898/191真实反弹狂信后由反弹者成为对象，原持有者无狂信；2467完整技能按先施加狂信后检查状态
interaction.assertion: test('4898/191真实反弹狂信后由反弹者成为对象，原持有者无狂信；2467完整技能按先施加狂信后检查状态',()=>{const s=make({move:29339,index:1});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'狂信',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['狂信'],undefined);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['狂信']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState.faithSourceSide,0);for(const mode of['success','immune','other']){const a=make({move:29339});if(mode!=='success')a.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;if(mode==='other')a.fighters[1].ailments['中毒']=3;turn(a);assert.equal(!!a.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,mode==='immune');}});

instance.description: 100%令对手狂信，触发后2回合内对手主动切换精灵则若当回合开始后100%令对手狂信

raw.description: 使用时，若对方精灵均拥有信仰对象，则本次技能视为命中并强制执行命中效果；4回合内免疫并反弹所有受到的异常状态；100%令对手狂信，触发后2回合内对手主动切换精灵则若当回合开始后100%令对手狂信；对手不处于异常状态时对手2回合内属性技能无效；对方精灵均拥有信仰对象时，为对方所有精灵恢复404点体力并附加404点固定伤害，然后若对方精灵的已损失体力值存在众数，则秒杀所有不为众数的精灵

review.rationale: 仅原文明示全队/唯一存活/主动换宠的条件或分支延期，当前个人信仰、伤害、回复、狂信、转移等全部已知分支状态测试；三个未确认单体定义仍明确阻塞，不以名称或引擎缺口豁免。
review.singleBehavior: 当前命中100%狂信，经正常免异/反弹与公共异常机制；首次进入设置来源为信仰对象，异常结束保留该对象，已有对象不覆盖，真实行动控制与PP不消耗已测。
review.deferredBehavior: 成功施加后2回合内实际对方主动换宠时，下个回合开始100%向新的当前对手施加狂信。

success.name: 4898/1562真实狂信首次建立信仰对象并阻止对对象行动；清除异常不清对象，已有其他对象不覆盖
success.assertion: test('4898/1562真实狂信首次建立信仰对象并阻止对对象行动；清除异常不清对象，已有其他对象不覆盖',()=>{for(const previous of[undefined,1]){const s=make({move:29339,index:2});(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=previous;turn(s,29339,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState?.faithSourceSide,previous??0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp['wiki:20117'],s.moveDefinitions['wiki:20117'].pp-(previous===1?1:0));assert.ok(s.fighters[1].ailments['狂信']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.pendingSwitchFaith4898.turns,2);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearAilments(c.t);},()=>turn(s,29339,null));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].statusState?.faithSourceSide,previous??0);}});

success.name: 4898/993狂信才全属性翻倍；58后两回必暴843后两回先制2，当前无额外先制
success.assertion: test('4898/993狂信才全属性翻倍；58后两回必暴843后两回先制2，当前无额外先制',()=>{for(const faith of[false,true]){const s=make({move:29340,index:1});if(faith)s.fighters[1].ailments['狂信']=3;turn(s,29340,null);assert.ok(Object.values(s.fighters[0].stages).every(n=>n===(faith?2:1)));}const s=make({move:29340,loadout:[29340,11141,20276,20567,38375]});turn(s,29340,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,0);for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){let crit;const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,run(e,c){old.run(e,c);if(e==='afterAttack'&&c.a.side===0)crit=c.crit;}};try{turn(s,11141,null);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,r<=3?2:0);assert.equal(crit,r<=3);}});

success.assertion: test('4898/4自身特攻一级、5重复双降与概率弱攻、33真实清强、31多段红伤、76固定100连续五回',()=>{const a=make({move:20276});turn(a);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].stages.spa,1);const b=make({move:20565});turn(b,20565,null);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.atk,-1);assert.equal(b.fighters[1].stages.spa,-1);const c=make({move:11148});c.fighters[1].stages.def=2;turn(c,11148,null);assert.equal(c.fighters[1].stages.def,0);const d=make({move:10703});turn(d,10703,null);assert.ok(d.damageEvents.filter(e=>e.type==='attack'&&e.sourceSide===0).length>=2);const e=make({move:11143,loadout:[11143,20276,11141,20567,38375]});for(let r=1;r<=6;r++){turn(e,r===1?11143:20276,20117);assert.equal(sum(e,'fixed'),r<=5?100:0);}const weak=new Set(),fear=new Set();for(let seed=1;seed<=32;seed++){const w=make({move:11144,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(w,11144,null);weak.add(w.fighters[1].stages.atk);const f=make({move:11147,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(f,11147,null);fear.add(!!f.fighters[1].ailments['害怕']);}assert.deepEqual([...weak].sort(),[-1,0]);assert.deepEqual([...fear].sort(),[false,true]);});

success.assertion: test('4898/1689当前攻击暴击不触发PP，本次未暴击结束立即恢复削减',()=>{const s=make({move:38374,index:2});timer(s,0,'必定暴击');turn(s,38374,null);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38374)],s.moveDefinitions[key(38374)].pp-1);for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[k],s.moveDefinitions[k].pp);const a=make({move:38374,index:2});turn(a);assert.equal(a.round,2);assert.equal(a.fighters[0].pp[key(38374)],a.moveDefinitions[key(38374)].pp);});

success.name: 4898已答1689：本次非暴击结束立即回全PP2并削敌全PP1，当前暴击不执行；零红仍执行、PP保护和回复封锁分别生效
success.assertion: for(const mode of['normal','crit','zero','protect','restore-blocked']){const s=make({move:38374,index:2});s.fighters[0].pp[key(38374)]=2;for(const k of s.fighters[0].moves.filter(k=>k!==key(38374)))s.fighters[0].pp[k]=Math.max(0,s.moveDefinitions[k].pp-2);for(const k of s.fighters[1].moves)s.fighters[1].pp[k]=5;if(mode==='crit')timer(s,0,'必定暴击');if(mode==='zero')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='protect')timer(s,1,'PP保护');if(mode==='restore-blocked'){timer(s,1,'机械领域',{fraction:.6});s.fighters[1].soulState.bedPartnerPP=true;}let checked=false;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){assert.equal(c.t.pp[key(38374)],['crit','restore-blocked'].includes(mode)?1:3);for(const k of c.a.moves)assert.equal(c.a.pp[k],(['crit','protect'].includes(mode)?5:4)-(k===key(20117)?1:0));checked=true;}},()=>turn(s,38374,20117));assert.equal(checked,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20117)],['crit','protect'].includes(mode)?4:3);assert.ok(Number.isFinite(s.fighters[1].hp));}

success.name: 4898/2465拥有任一信仰对象才吸取最大体力三分之一，免疫和残血不减理论回复，技能禁疗只封回复
success.assertion: test('4898/2465拥有任一信仰对象才吸取最大体力三分之一，免疫和残血不减理论回复，技能禁疗只封回复',()=>{for(const mode of['none','pope','self','immune','low','healban']){const s=make({move:38375,index:3,hp:1000,targetHp:mode==='low'?1:9000});if(mode!=='none')(s.fighters[1].statusState??={}).faithSourceSide=mode==='self'?1:0;if(mode==='low')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');if(mode==='immune')timer(s,1,'固定百分比免疫');if(mode==='healban')timer(s,0,'无法通过自身技能恢复体力');turn(s,38375,20117);const drain=mode!=='none';assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),!drain||mode==='immune'?0:3000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,drain&&mode!=='healban'?4000:1000);if(mode==='pope'||mode==='self')assert.ok(s.fighters[1].hp>0);}});
